limit.description: Maximum number of editions to return in this page.

offset.description: Number of matching editions to skip in the provider's ordered result set.

identifiers.description: Identifiers describing one book. An edition qualifies when at least one supplied issuer/value pair matches exactly. Unknown identifiers do not invalidate other matches.

schema.description: Resolve one identifier bag. Batch resolution is not defined in this version.

main.description: Resolve one book by exact equality of at least one identifier issuer/value pair. Shared grouping identifiers may match several editions. Results are in provider-defined relevance order. This operation does not write user records.
